content.text:
## Workspace summary: `personal-page`

Small static portfolio - no framework, package manager, backend, or git repo yet. About 6 source files.

### 1. Tech stack

| Layer | Choice |
|--------|--------|
| UI | Plain HTML / CSS / ES modules |
| 3D cards | [Three.js](https://threejs.org/) `0.172.0` via CDN import map + `CSS3DRenderer` |
| Backend | None |
| Build | None (no `package.json`, Vite, Next, etc.) |
| Local serve | `python3 -m http.server` via `scripts/dev.sh` |

Key paths:
- `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/personal-page/index.html`
- `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/personal-page/main.js`
- `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/personal-page/styles.css`
- `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/personal-page/scripts/dev.sh`

### 2. How content is stored

Hybrid JSON + hardcoded JS - not MDX/CMS.

1. **Manifest JSON** (rich projects with modal + optional embed), listed in `PROJECT_MANIFESTS`:
   - `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/personal-page/projects/sots.json`
2. **Inline `STATIC_PROJECTS`** in `main.js` (simple link-out cards: Dotfiles, FYP)
3. **Assets** under `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/personal-page/assets/projects/` (e.g. `sots-preview.svg`)

Example manifest shape (`sots.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "sots",
  "tag": "Research",
  "title": "Simplification of Trajectory Streams",
  "description": "...",
  "url": "https://github.com/...",
  "detail": {
    "summary": "...",
    "screenshot": "./assets/projects/sots-preview.svg",
    "paperUrl": "https://arxiv.org/abs/...",
    "embedUrl": {
      "development": "http://127.0.0.1:5050",
      "production": ""
    }
  }
}
```

Simple projects only need `tag`, `title`, `description`, `url` (no `detail`).

### 3. Search / chat / AI

None. No search UI, chat, LLM APIs, or embeddings. Interaction is 3D card spin, modal detail, GitHub/paper links, and iframe “glimpse” embed.

### 4. Architecture

```
index.html
  ├─ #canvas-container  → Three.js CSS3D project cards
  ├─ #project-modal     → detail (screenshot, summary, actions)
  └─ #embed-view        → full-page iframe for live demos

main.js
  loadProjects() → fetch JSON manifests + merge STATIC_PROJECTS
  initCards()    → CSS3D scene, pointer spin, click → modal or GitHub
  initModal()    → detail + “Take a glimpse”
  initEmbed()    → iframe; localhost uses embedUrl.development
```

Local demo wiring (`dev.sh`): serves this site on `:8765` and optionally starts a sibling SOTS visualizer at `../Simplification-of-Trajectory-Streams/web` on `:5050` for the glimpse embed.

### Deployment

No deploy config visible (no GitHub Actions, Vercel, Netlify, `CNAME`, etc.). Not a git repo yet. Suitable for any static host (GitHub Pages, Netlify, S3, etc.). Production embed URL for SOTS is currently empty (`"production": ""`), so glimpse would only work when a production URL is set or in local dev.
